_doc: Every physical constant the simulator uses. verified=true: a published spec, quoted from the source URL. verified=false: a labelled placeholder (the value was not published or not found); the simulator's results that depend on it are approximate. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md renders this table.

nominalVoltage.note: A charged NiMH pack reads above nominal; the simulator holds the nominal value and models no sag.

rotorInertia.source: placeholder: REV publishes no rotor inertia; only affects how fast a free shaft spins up

defaultStack.source: placeholder: the SDK's UltraPlanetary motor type assumes nominal 20:1 (@MotorType gearing=20); the real stack is whatever the team built, set it per motor in the simulator

efficiency.source: placeholder: REV publishes no UltraPlanetary efficiency

gearRatio.note: The SDK's @MotorType for Core Hex says gearing=36.25, maxRPM=137; REV's product page says 72:1, 125 rpm. The simulator uses REV's numbers for physics and the SDK's for the SDK's own ticks-per-second scaling.

freeCurrent.source: NOT FOUND: REV does not publish the Core Hex no-load current; 0 means no friction is modelled

countsPerMotorRev.source: https://docs.revrobotics.com/duo-build/motion/motors/core-hex-motor ("At the motor - 4 counts/revolution"; 288 at the output)

stallTorqueAtOutputPerRatio.source: placeholder for motor types that are not in the FGC kit (NeveRest, goBILDA, Tetrix...): free speed and gearing come from the SDK's @MotorType annotation, torque is this placeholder times the gearing

freeShaftInertia.source: placeholder: hex shaft + hub + gear on an otherwise free output

robotMass.source: placeholder: bench approximation of the robot mass shared by the drive wheels; only sets how fast drive wheels spin up

rangeDeg.source: https://docs.revrobotics.com/rev-crossover-products/servo/smart-robot-servo-v2 ("The default range for the SRS V2 is 270°. This range is mapped to an input pulse range of 500μs to 2500μs with 1500μs as the center point.")

continuousFreeSpeed.source: placeholder: REV publishes no continuous-mode speed; this is the angular-mode slew rate (60°/0.14 s) reused

pulseIncreasesCounterClockwise.unit: 1 = a longer pulse turns the output CCW seen from the spline
pulseIncreasesCounterClockwise.source: placeholder: REV does not document which way the SRS turns for a longer pulse; the servo arc labels 0 and 1 so the relative motion is still right

defaultPulseUpperUs.note: With the default 'Servo' configuration type, positions 0..1 drive 600..2400 µs, i.e. 243° of an SRS's 270°; 'ServoFullRange' uses 500..2500.

outOfRangeMm.source: placeholder: what the VL53L0X reports with nothing in range is not documented by REV or the FTC SDK (the SDK only passes the chip's reading through: VL53L0X.getDistance); 8190 is the commonly reported chip value

countsWhiteAt10mm.source: placeholder: raw colour counts depend on gain, integration time and the target; REV publishes no reference. Thresholds on raw red()/green()/blue() will differ from the real sensor.

maxVolts.source: placeholder: linear 0..3.3 V over 270° assumed; REV states the hub reads 0-5 V and the SDK's getMaxVoltage() is 3.3, but gives no output curve for the potentiometer

commandMsControlHub.source: gm0.org (community, not REV): https://gm0.org/en/latest/docs/software/adv-control-system/sdk-communication.html "approximately 2 milliseconds over UART"

commandMsExpansionHub.source: gm0.org (community, not REV): same page, "approximately 3 milliseconds over USB"; an RS485-linked Expansion Hub is assumed to cost the same

i2cMs.source: gm0.org (community, not REV): same page, "upwards of 7 milliseconds over USB"

failsafeDelayMs.source: FTC SDK 11.2.0 OpModeManagerImpl.DefaultOpMode SAFE_WAIT_NANOS = 100 ms (motors set to 0 at stop, hub failsafe after)

velocityLoopKp.source: approximation: the hub firmware's velocity PIDF is closed source; RUN_USING_ENCODER / RUN_TO_POSITION speeds are approximate

positionLoopGain.source: approximation of the hub firmware's position loop (closed source)

sdkCallCostUs.unit: µs of sim time per SDK call that does not reach a hub
sdkCallCostUs.source: placeholder for the Control Hub CPU time of an SDK call; sets loop time when a loop sends no hub commands
